params.caption: 🎮 No Sony game in Game of the Year at The Game Awards for the first time in 11 years The Game Awards 2026 GOTY shortlist has no PlayStation-published title. Every year since 2015, at least one Sony-published game had made the GOTY nominees. This year's list is led by GTA 6 with eight nominations, and the show airs on December 10. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 22:17 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC 👥 @PlayStation · @thegameawards 😮 React if you're surprised · 💬 Which Sony game deserved a spot? #TheGameAwards #PlayStation #GOTY #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
